name: AI Wire
tagline: AIWire is a free, no-signup news aggregator that pulls the day's AI and developer news onto one page — then uses AI to tell you what actually matters
description: AIWire is a free, no-signup news aggregator that pulls the day's AI and developer news onto one page — then uses AI to tell you what actually matters. Every two hours it scans 80+ sources — AI research labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind), tech press, and developer blogs — and a Gemini-powered curator groups the noise into 8 ranked story clusters, each with a two-sentence summary and an importance score.
